works.title: Concentration, Scale, and the Extractors: A Position Statement
works.description: A foundational position statement articulating the user's core political philosophy on power concentration, scale-matching of decision-making authority, and extraction dynamics in institutions. Argues that the core political distinction is not left vs. right but rather between concentrated and distributed power, and emphasizes how local decision-makers should capture the consequences of their choices.
works.quote: Concentration, Scale, and the Extractors. A position statement. Start with the axis that actually matters.
